label: SIMULATED: assumed feed latency (licensed feed not purchased); parameters measured; trades selected on outcomes, not ex ante

conventions.capital: 3 x peak dollars locked (src/tier0.py CAPITAL_MULT, LOCK_S 4 h)
conventions.statistics: per seed, then the mean over 20 seeds (the paper's CV convention); ratio_of_seed_means divides seed-mean dollars by seed-mean capital (the paper's table uses these, so a cell's return has the sign of its mean $ a day)
conventions.fees_x2: P&L minus the taker fees once more; the fill price already walks the measured stale book, so there is no separate spread charge
conventions.fee: taker fee r q (1 - q) a share at the match's published fee rate (0 where no schedule was published)

check.note: every seed's P&L, Sharpe, max drawdown and capital equal results/tier0/latency_sweep_seeds.csv; seed means equal results/tier0/latency_sweep.json
